text:
matt: Kicking off staged rollout for service-api v2.3.1 -> 15% global, change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. tagging @ops-oncall and @sara for observability. deploy-bot please kick.

deploy-bot: Started rollout: `shift-traffic --service service-api --version v2.3.1 --percent 15`
Canary regions: us-east1, eu-west1, ap-south1. Monitor p95/p99 and error-rate. CI: green. :rocket:

sara: watching dashboards — will post notable signals. set alert on p95 > 200ms for eu-west.

arjun: quick heads-up: I see a small KV cache miss spike in eu-west around the shift start, might explain latency blip. pulling logs.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics (t+3m): overall error-rate +0.1%, eu-west p95 230ms (+120ms baseline), us-east1 stable, ap-south1 stable.

sara: eu-west p95 sustained at 220-240ms for last 2 minutes. Not huge but above our gate of 200ms. Traffic is ~3.2k rps there.

ops-oncall: @matt @arjun please confirm — do we want to continue to 25% or hold? I'm leaning hold and partial rollback for eu-west only.

arjun: Agree with hold. I can push a regional pin: reduce eu-west traffic to 2% or rollback to v2.3.0 there. The rest of globe can stay at 15% if we want to proceed carefully.

matt: Let's not escalate. Hold global progress (no more increments). Do regional mitigation: reduce eu-west to 2% first, keep other regions capped. If p95 recovers within 5m, we can unroll decision.

deploy-bot: Executing: `adjust-traffic --service service-api --version v2.3.1 --region eu-west1 --percent 2`
Result: success. New distribution: global 15% (eu-west1 2%).

sara: after adjustment eu-west p95 dropped to 185ms within ~90s. Error-rate normalized. Good to see quick recovery. :thumbsup:

jane: I'll update release notes and open a post-mortem ticket to track root cause (KV cache warm / rollout timing). tagging infra team. ticket: INFRA-4281

matt: Plan: (1) keep global at current state, do not ramp to 25% until tomorrow's bake window, (2) infra to investigate cache warm behavior and publish mitigations, (3) ops will monitor for 30m, (4) release notes + CC to customers if anything was user-impacting. Agreed?

arjun: Agreed. I'll also add an auto-warm job suggestion to the ticket — prepopulate KV for new version. Will follow up with a quick runbook entry.

ops-oncall: ack. I'll keep alerts muted for noisy bursts and only escalate if p95 > 300ms or error-rate +0.5% sustained.

sara: adding a synthetic test to the dashboard that hits cache hot paths for v2.3.1.

matt: Thanks all. Leaving thread open for updates. If anything regresses, we'll roll back EU to v2.3.0 fully. :white_check_mark:
